section: Flight over Fight — Escape to the Clouds
access: Google Drive connector fetch; source text inspected during this run
verified: Once airborne, at least twelve Wing Guard cloud cars pursue
They engage the PCs ship in squadrons of four at a time
Storm IV cloud car and Bespin Defense Force pilot stat blocks are adjacent to the section
Vehicle and minion combat rules are referenced to Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook p.238
implementationLimits: Exactly twelve vehicles are modeled as the published minimum; additional reinforcements are not simulated
Airborne state, arrivals, positions and pilots require GM physical confirmation; no movement or arrival is inferred
No automatic XP, enemy defeat, damage, or extra NPC attacks
Pilot rank is zero when minion is alone; group skills are not assigned a fabricated rank
